crossRefs.note: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now…
The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

people.name: Bilhah
people.line: Rachel's maidservant and mother of Dan and Naphtali

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
translations.bsb: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
translations.asv: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
